digest.component_or_area: runner.py module structure and LLM execution
propositions: runner.py is exactly 800 LOC, sitting at the hard cap with zero headroom for new code in stories 2932 and 343b

Structured-output execution cluster (_pai_structured, _extract_usage, _warn_if_zeroed_usage, effective_max_iterations, effective_max_tokens, _FAULTY_OUTPUT_SNIPPET_CHARS) forms a genuine call-graph seam with no external dependencies except RunRequest (annotation-only under TYPE_CHECKING) and usage_log

Extracting the 148-LOC structured-output cluster to new leaf module structured_run.py reduces runner.py to ~657 LOC with real headroom and keeps structured_run.py at ~165–175 LOC above the 100-LOC floor
All reference sites for moved symbols must be located via AST symbol-reference query plus string-literal grep for monkeypatch targets, which LSP cannot resolve structurally
Behaviour must be preserved with zero test-logic edits; all 7517 baseline tests plus 7 new seam tests must pass unchanged after import sites and patch targets are updated
